## Core Solutions
1. **CCTV & AI Surveillance Systems**: IP & HD CCTV cameras, night-vision perimeter monitoring, Video Door Phones (VDP), NVR racks, mobile remote viewing.
2. **Biometric Attendance & Access Control**: Fingerprint & facial recognition terminals, turnstiles, electromagnetic door locks.
3. **Interactive Flat Panels & Smart Classrooms**: 4K touch interactive panels for lecture halls and corporate boardrooms.
4. **Laptops, Desktops & Enterprise IT Supply**: Bulk institutional procurement, GeM tender fulfillment, OEM warranty & AMC.
5. **Networking & Server Infrastructure**: Structured Cat6/fiber cabling, server racks, enterprise LAN/Wi-Fi.
6. **Fire Alarm & Public Address Systems**: Smoke/heat detection panels, campus PA announcement networks.
